# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 N2 phase 1, the Turkish emirates (Umur's era). Generated by gen_beyliks.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 18); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): close in 1446.1.1, bookkeeping, world steps, then at most one event in a
# calm, free month.
oe_bey_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_off } }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1446.1.1 } set_variable = oe_bey_off }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_bey_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
            oe_bey_book = yes
            oe_bey_world = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_bey_calm = yes oe_ml_free = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_bey_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 2 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = 20 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 3 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = 15 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 1 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_2 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 2 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_3 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 3 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_1 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 1 } }
                remove_variable = oe_bey_pick
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends an event of the monthly check (it is marked fired just before, above).
oe_bey_fire = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_bey_st value = $n$ }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bey.$n$
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Bookkeeping, no pop-ups (design 3.3, phase-1 part; phase 2 adds oe_bey_grace_m after W-9).
oe_bey_book = {
    # Umur first seen dead (any cause): .2 may come in the next 6 months.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_umur_dead } NOT = { character:ayd_umur ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
        set_variable = oe_bey_umur_dead
        set_variable = { name = oe_bey_umur_m value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_bey: Umur is dead (W-1 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_world_a')|0])"
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bey_umur_m } change_variable = { name = oe_bey_umur_m add = 1 } }
    # The strong route ended the contest of the Roman world: the Ottoman part of this line is void (decision 3).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_void } international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world ?= { has_variable = oe_rw_contest_ended } }
        set_variable = oe_bey_void
    }
    # The chronicle's void: before 1348 none of the five western emirates is left (design 4.4).
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_gone }
            current_date < 1348.1.1
            NOT = { country_exists = c:AYD }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:SRU }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:GRM }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:KAR }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:MEN }
        }
        set_variable = oe_bey_gone
    }
    # Windows that passed without their event.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_1 } var:oe_bey_m > 46 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_2 } OR = { var:oe_bey_m > 348 AND = { has_variable = oe_bey_umur_m var:oe_bey_umur_m > 6 } } } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_3 } var:oe_bey_m > 348 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_3 value = 2 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. World steps W-1..W-4 (global variables oe_bey_w<n>: 1 done, 2 window passed without it). Only when
# every country involved is AI (decision 52); no pop-up, no lock. Phase 2 adds W-5..W-9a here, phase 3 W-9b and W-10.
oe_bey_world = {
    # W-1
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w1 } var:oe_bey_m >= 135 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_m <= 140 oe_bey_w1_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_bey_wch_1 oe_bey_w1_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w1 value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w1 } var:oe_bey_m >= 140 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w1 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W-2
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w2 } var:oe_bey_m >= 140 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_m <= 156 oe_bey_w2_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_bey_wch_2 oe_bey_w2_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w2 value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w2 } var:oe_bey_m >= 156 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w2 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W-3
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w3 } var:oe_bey_m >= 5 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_m <= 12 oe_bey_w3_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_bey_wch_3 oe_bey_w3_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w3 value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w3 } var:oe_bey_m >= 12 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w3 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W-4
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w4 } var:oe_bey_m >= 55 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_m <= 72 oe_bey_w4_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_bey_wch_4 oe_bey_w4_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w4 value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w4 } var:oe_bey_m >= 72 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w4 value = 2 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. W-1: Umur falls before the harbour castle of Smyrna (spring 1348); the heir succeeds by itself.
oe_bey_w1_do = {
    kill_character = { target = character:ayd_umur reason = siege location = location:smyrna }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-1: Umur falls before the harbour castle of Smyrna"
}
# BYZ scope. W-2: Khidr's peace with the Latins (August 1348): half the port dues to the Latins, the fleet laid up.
oe_bey_w2_do = {
    c:AYD = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_latin_customs years = 15 mode = replace } }
    c:VEN ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_latin_peace target = c:AYD } } }
    c:KNI ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_latin_peace target = c:AYD } } }
    c:CYP ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_latin_peace target = c:AYD } } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-2: Khidr's peace with the Latins"
}
# BYZ scope. W-3: Menteshe's new treaty with Venice (Crete); Venetian merchants back at Balat (1337).
oe_bey_w3_do = {
    location:balat = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_balat_trade years = 10 mode = replace } }
    c:MEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_balat target = c:VEN } }
    c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_balat target = c:MEN } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-3: the Venetians at Balat"
}
# BYZ scope. W-4: Germiyan takes in its vassal Sahib Ata (1341), a peaceful transfer.
oe_bey_w4_do = {
    c:GRM = { annex_country = { country = c:SHP reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-4: Sahib Ata joins Germiyan"
}

# BYZ scope. Pay / gain $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_bey_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
oe_bey_gain = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }

# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_bey.90 (var:oe_bey_do): 2 the raid of .1 a, 3 the alliance broken in .2 b, 6 the
# watch on the Hellespont of .3 a. (Phase 2: 1 Philadelphia handed over, 4 the restored emirates; phase 3: 5 Ankara
# and Kütahya sacked.)
oe_bey_do_job = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 2 } oe_bey_raid = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 3 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:AYD has_mutual_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:alliance target = c:AYD } }
            remove_relation = { type = relation_type:alliance first = c:BYZ second = c:AYD }
        }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 6 } oe_bey_watch = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_bey_do
}
# BYZ scope. .1 a: back from the Black Sea with the loot; Kilia is sacked and its owner (and Wallachia) remember it.
# Only AI countries are hit (a player's Kilia or Wallachia is left alone).
oe_bey_raid = {
    oe_bey_gain = { months = 2 }
    location:chilia = {
        if = {
            limit = { owner ?= { is_ai = yes NOT = { tag = BYZ } } }
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace }
            owner = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_raided target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
    c:WAL ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = yes NOT = { location:chilia = { owner ?= c:WAL } } }
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_raided target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_bey .1 a: sailed with Umur into the Black Sea"
}
# BYZ scope. .3 a: the empire's places in the Dardanelles province gain the watch on the Hellespont for 20 years.
oe_bey_watch = {
    location:gallipoli = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:enez = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:hayrabolu = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:malgara = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:rodoscuk = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:kesan = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (test page, observer logs).
oe_bey_log = { debug_log = "oe_bey cw=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_counterweight')|0] sea=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_blacksea')|0] umur=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_umur')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_umur_m')|0] strait=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_strait')|0] done=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_done')|0] world=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_world_a')|0]" }

# BYZ scope. Forget this line's state, so its events can be tested again. Deaths, annexations, other countries'
# opinions and location modifiers stay.
oe_bey_test_reset = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_bey_karesi_exiles } remove_country_modifier = oe_bey_karesi_exiles }
    remove_variable = oe_bey_m
    remove_variable = oe_bey_st
    remove_variable = oe_bey_do
    remove_variable = oe_bey_pick
    remove_variable = oe_bey_blacksea
    remove_variable = oe_bey_umur
    remove_variable = oe_bey_strait
    remove_variable = oe_bey_umur_dead
    remove_variable = oe_bey_umur_m
    remove_variable = oe_bey_void
    remove_variable = oe_bey_gone
    remove_variable = oe_bey_off
    remove_variable = oe_bey_done_1
    remove_variable = oe_bey_done_2
    remove_variable = oe_bey_done_3
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w1
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w2
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w3
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w4
}
